messages.content: Infer alternative executable programs explaining the observed examples. Return only JSON: {"programs":[{"steps":[...]}]}. Return 1 to 8 programs, each with 2 to 4 steps. Inputs x0,x1 are integer lists. Step i assigns x(i+2). Each step has exactly op and args; higher-order steps also have lambda. args are names of earlier variables, not literals. After the first step, each step must use the preceding step result. The last result is the output. Any intermediate out-of-range integer or undefined operation gives ERROR for the entire program. All intermediate integers must be in [-50,50]. JSON null in an observed output denotes ERROR. Lambda divisions use floor division, including negative integers. No prose, Python, weights or fitted constants. The source prior chooses length uniformly from 2,3,4 and each subsequent step uniformly from the type-valid operation/lambda/argument tuples satisfying the previous-result rule. Input list lengths are uniform 1..5 and elements uniform -10..10, independently of the hidden program.

{"history":[{"inputs":[[5,3,7,-5,5],[-10,9,3,-3]],"output":null},{"inputs":[[-4,1,-4],[-4,3,7]],"output":[-4,3,7]}],"operations":[{"args":["list"],"op":"Head","output_type":"int","semantics":"first list element; ERROR on empty list"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Last","output_type":"int","semantics":"last list element; ERROR on empty list"},{"args":["int","list"],"op":"Take","output_type":"list","semantics":"Python xs[:n], including Python negative slice semantics"},{"args":["int","list"],"op":"Drop","output_type":"list","semantics":"Python xs[n:], including Python negative slice semantics"},{"args":["int","list"],"op":"Access","output_type":"int","semantics":"xs[n] only when 0 <= n < len(xs); otherwise ERROR"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Minimum","output_type":"int","semantics":"minimum list element; ERROR on empty list"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Maximum","output_type":"int","semantics":"maximum list element; ERROR on empty list"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Reverse","output_type":"list","semantics":"reverse the list"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Sort","output_type":"list","semantics":"sort ascending"},{"args":["list"],"op":"Sum","output_type":"int","semantics":"sum list elements; zero for empty list"},{"args":["list"],"lambda_choices":["(+1)","(-1)","(*2)","(/2)","(*(-1))","(**2)","(*3)","(/3)","(*4)","(/4)"],"op":"Map","output_type":"list","semantics":"apply the chosen unary integer lambda to each element"},{"args":["list"],"lambda_choices":["(>0)","(<0)","(%2==0)","(%2==1)"],"op":"Filter","output_type":"list","semantics":"keep elements satisfying the chosen predicate"},{"args":["list"],"lambda_choices":["(>0)","(<0)","(%2==0)","(%2==1)"],"op":"Count","output_type":"int","semantics":"count elements satisfying the chosen predicate"},{"args":["list","list"],"lambda_choices":["(+)","(-)","(*)","(min)","(max)"],"op":"ZipWith","output_type":"list","semantics":"apply binary lambda to paired elements; stop at shorter list"},{"args":["list"],"lambda_choices":["(+)","(-)","(*)","(min)","(max)"],"op":"Scanl1","output_type":"list","semantics":"left cumulative binary lambda; retain first element; empty gives empty"}]}
